name: srs-benchmark-raw
description: A raw dataset for evaluating spaced-repetition systems and models that predict human memory retention. It contains user review histories, item metadata, and timing information to measure how well models predict recall and schedule reviews.
evaluation_method: AUC / RMSE (prediction accuracy over recall probabilities)
reputation: A focused dataset in the spaced-repetition and educational-research community, used by a small number of researchers interested in memory modeling and scheduling.
